name: Desembarco del Granma National Park
description: Around Cabo Cruz on Cuba's far southeastern coast, this park rises from the Caribbean in a staircase of ancient marine terraces, old seabed lifted into great stone steps and carved by waves and rain into caves and sinkholes. Its sea cliffs are among the most pristine in the region. The name recalls the yacht Granma, which brought Fidel Castro and his companions ashore here in 1956.
